init_distrib_slurm: initialize torch distributed process group using SLURM or torch.distributed.launch environment variables
rank0_only: use as a decorator or condition to restrict code execution to world rank 0 only
gatherv: gather variable-size 1D tensors from all ranks into a single rank using ring all-gather
gather_objects: gather arbitrary Python objects from all distributed ranks to a single output rank
add_signal_handlers: register signal handlers for clean exit, state save, and SLURM job requeue on SIGTERM SIGUSR1 SIGUSR2
